title: Printed indoor routes keep museum visitors satisfied during weather closures
description: Show how a free sculpture route gives visitors a satisfying fallback when a flooded garden is closed. In the museum's two April openings, the front desk issued 38 printed routes.
audience: Museum visitors planning to see the sculpture garden
rationale: The handout count demonstrates that the substitute route protects the visitor experience. The museum can use the story to explain the indoor option during temporary closures.
evidence: The museum handed out 38 printed routes at two April Sunday openings. The route follows step-free public corridors from the desk to the café.
